experiment_contract.hypothesis: The authenticated Workana dashboard exposes an explicit moderation marker that can classify the profile as APPROVED_EXPLICIT, REJECTED_EXPLICIT, PENDING_SIGNAL or UNKNOWN without external side effects.
experiment_contract.success: Runner writes a sanitized PASS result to the pre-created challenge and Nexia directly verifies it remotely.
experiment_contract.failure: Browser/auth/writeback fails, a password field is observed, target URL differs, or classification cannot be produced safely.
experiment_contract.truth_rule: UNKNOWN is not approval. Approval may be promoted only when an explicit approval marker is detected.

authority_effect: NONE. This probe is read-only within existing authority and does not authorize proposal submission, messaging, purchases, profile changes or publication.
next_gate: Kael manually launches the prepared read-only probe once; Nexia then reads the GitHub challenge directly.
